summary: Join our Gender Equality and Economic Empowerment Training Course to learn essential skills for fostering equality and enhancing economic opportunities for all.
lede: Economic empowerment through gender equality involves identifying barriers and shaping inclusive policies, budgets, and programs. For professionals, policymakers, and organizational leaders, the course applies gender analysis and gender-disaggregated data to assess how decisions affect equality. It also covers developing gender-responsive budget proposals, addressing workplace bias, and measuring empowerment outcomes so participants can strengthen decisions across their organization or development work.
audienceIntro: This training is ideal for professionals, policymakers, and organizational leaders across sectors who want to strengthen gender-responsive approaches in their work, including:
audience: Women empowerment advocates and social entrepreneurs
modules: Understanding Gender Equality and Economic Empowerment
